title: meum mutellina
intro: Meum mutellina, commonly known as meum or mountain meum, is a perennial herbaceous plant in the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation and fighting against infections. The therapeutic actions of Meum mutellina include its use as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Meum mutellina include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic properties.
